verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents custom dashboards for cost, latency, volume, and quality, and cost dashboards that can be broken down by model, tag, or user. Score metrics are also queryable through the Metrics API v2, which covers the eval-score part. Error-rate metrics are never mentioned, so the story is only partly covered. missing for 10: evidence of error/failure-rate metrics in dashboards, detail on dashboard customization depth (widgets, filters, chart types), independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboards.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics
